methodology.newcomer_definition: Technically literate newcomer without project documentation; assess complete visible frontend, with first-fold hierarchy noted separately.
core_questions: What happened in this canonical run?
Why is there or is there not body movement?
What does this result not mean?
methodology.evidence_boundary: Screenshots support UX observations only; scientific values checked against canonical backend replay payloads.
methodology.browser: agent-browser controlled Chromium; real Next.js/FastAPI; no mocked scientific data.
methodology.automated_accessibility_tooling: No pre-existing axe/Playwright accessibility harness located; used keyboard, DOM labels/focus/size/overflow inspection without dependencies.
methodology.performance_scope: Local development observations under some concurrent audit requests; not production benchmarks or claims of user comprehension speed.

notes.result: Intentional no-stimulus control; neutral source states, model DNp01 resting coordinate -52 mV_eq, no spikes/actuation/displacement.
notes.hierarchy: Control cue visible in viewport; full intentional-null explanation below controls and causal panels.
notes.telemetry: Time/control status essential; no-object/exposure/zero-actuator/body coordinates repeat null result.
notes.causal: Disabled sensory stage and stationary body clear; 'yet' wording is unnecessarily anticipatory.
notes.provenance: Collapsed by default; model-space voltage/distance definitions explicit when opened.
notes.accessibility: Keyboard transport works with visible outline; shared navigation focus risk.
notes.asset: Large identifiable specimen; simplified mesh detail and leg/shadow overlap.

notes.result: 1.4 ms causal micro-window; exposure 19 to 22; final right DNp01 -51.933657842035174 mV_eq, left -52; zero genuine spikes/actuation/movement.
notes.hierarchy: Micro-window role named in header; null-result conclusion lies below causal panels.
notes.causal: World to sensory to DNp01 to motor/body clear; LC4/LPLC2 identities are in expanded detail.
notes.telemetry: Right target is the main value; bilateral exact targets available in details.
notes.provenance: Artifact/run IDs and unit limits secondary; not a behavior-scale escape experiment.
notes.visualization: One sphere only; dashed guide not another object; fly visible.
notes.accessibility: Keyboard range/Home/End and focus verified; no event semantics invented.

notes.result: 40 ms preregistered model-space probe; exposure 19 to 26; final right DNp01 -48.733429620244685 mV_eq, left -52; no spikes/actuation/movement.
notes.hierarchy: Longer experiment role explicit; result and 40 ms termination shown after causal section.
notes.causal: Sensory growth and subthreshold response explained; no physiological duration claim.
notes.telemetry: Exposure, target state and time useful; unchanged actuator/body fields repeat outcome.
notes.provenance: Includes preregistration and requested/completed horizon; units remain uncalibrated.
notes.visualization: Single approaching sphere with fixed body, grid and guide; front details partly crowded at final approach.
notes.accessibility: Mobile no overflow; labels readable but small; controls reachable.

notes.result: RIGHT_SIDE_MOTION; R input pulse then recovery, R HS/DNp15 response, left neutral; at 20 ms DNp15 R 0.746469 (rounded UI), L 0. No body mapping or event semantics.
notes.hierarchy: Viewport dominated by input panels; bilateral result and source identities much farther below.
notes.causal: Five explicit stages and six source/two target identities available without provenance; no selected-motif viewport inset.
notes.telemetry: R/L targets and differential essential; six identity cards useful secondary.
notes.provenance: Six active chemical routes, seven excluded routes, source IDs and model limits preserved.
notes.visualization: Text-labelled L/R stripe panels; explicitly presentation rather than retinal imagery.
notes.accessibility: Native transport/summary keyboard operable; mobile controls 40 px high.

notes.result: External +0.001 eq kick, subsequent counter-motion/reversals, final +0.00033277101655776 eq; clipping 0/500. No absolute heading-error signal.
notes.hierarchy: Exact orientation/residual caption inside viewport; full explanation and marginal-mode status below six causal panels.
notes.causal: Delayed feedback described; six cards plus return glyph, but row/column reading requires care.
notes.telemetry: Orientation, view-motion descriptor, R/L neural state, differential and clipping accurate; raw observation secondary.
notes.provenance: All phases and analytical IDs available, excluded recurrent/electrical context clearly inactive.
notes.visualization: World reference explicitly not a goal; direct orientation rotation small, not exaggerated. No translation.
notes.accessibility: Expanded mobile provenance no overflow; keyboard summaries work, transport reset zero and paused state stable.

library_evaluation.naming: Named roles differentiate the five experiments; course control correctly qualified as exploratory.
library_evaluation.hierarchy: Long two-column cards; start-here cue visible but four non-control cards share category styling.

findings.current_behavior: Library cards repeat description, preview, explanation and caveat; duration and body-output metadata are uneven. Most non-control cards share the same amber treatment.
findings.why_it_matters: Different experiment classes need a compact comparison before selection.
findings.scientific_risk: No false scenario is offered; class/scope distinctions take extended reading.
findings.ux_impact: Long cards push the fifth scenario below two large rows.
findings.phase33_remedy: Use consistent experiment type, scientific duration, input, output scope and canonical-result metadata; retain all five distinct identifiers.

findings.current_behavior: Cockpit order is identity, viewport, playback, causal cards, interpretation, telemetry, provenance. Desktop result starts around y=1290–1450 px.
findings.why_it_matters: The result should explain a quiet or subtle visualization before raw values.
findings.scientific_risk: Correct result exists, but may not be noticed during first inspection.
findings.ux_impact: Newcomer must scroll past controls and multiple panels to learn the outcome.
findings.phase33_remedy: Promote a concise current-result summary adjoining the dominant viewport; distinguish selected-boundary state from whole-run outcome.

findings.current_behavior: Neural viewport contains two stripe panels, not the selected eight-node motif. Six identity cards start around y=1953 px on desktop.
findings.why_it_matters: The experiment is a circuit validation, not only a motion stimulus.
findings.scientific_risk: No fake network is rendered; causal topology is less visually discoverable.
findings.ux_impact: Readers must assemble the six-source/two-target path from later cards.
findings.phase33_remedy: Pair descriptor presentation with a bounded, identity-labelled six-route motif readout driven only by backend states; exclude seven context edges.

findings.current_behavior: Direct cycle-to-angle rendering correctly preserves very small rotation; counter-motion and residual offset are difficult to discern geometrically without the numeric caption.
findings.why_it_matters: Subtle valid motion needs an explanatory readout rather than a larger gain.
findings.scientific_risk: Changing orientation gain would violate science; current values are correct.
findings.ux_impact: Visual scene alone does not explain the response or offset mode.
findings.phase33_remedy: Add truthful orientation/view-motion trend or geometric annotation with explicit model-space axes; preserve direct specimen orientation and final residual, with no scientific or visual gain retuning.

findings.current_behavior: Timeline primarily shows scientific boundary numbers. Neural pulse/recovery phases lack persistent interval markers; course interval text runs immediately after the presentation-speed sentence.
findings.why_it_matters: Meaningful stimulus and recovery boundaries are more useful than an unlabeled range.
findings.scientific_risk: No timing error found; phase context is easy to miss.
findings.ux_impact: Scrubbing is responsive but interpretation requires nearby copy.
findings.phase33_remedy: Annotate phases from authoritative descriptors/perturbation metadata; separate scientific and presentation time clearly; retain keyboard scrub, exact reset and final-state persistence.

findings.current_behavior: Result, causal cards and telemetry repeat stationary/no-command/time labels. Neural telemetry has five cells in a three-column grid, leaving an empty sixth slot. Course drive and clipping share one value line.
findings.why_it_matters: Telemetry should prioritize understanding over dashboard density.
findings.ux_impact: Fragmented cards and repeated statements compete with the central experiment.
findings.phase33_remedy: Use a compact primary readout and expandable secondary values; keep paired R/L targets comparable and preserve sign/zero; separate clipping status from drive.

findings.current_behavior: Technical unit tokens are visible, but important plain-language definitions often sit in collapsed provenance; source state alternates between signed proxy and dimensionless_signed_proxy.
findings.why_it_matters: Units need to be clear without interpreting a variable name.
findings.scientific_risk: Possible novice physical interpretation of mV_eq or orientation is mitigated by existing model-space qualifiers, not eliminated by the token alone.
findings.ux_impact: Long labels and nine-place decimals make reading effort uneven.
findings.phase33_remedy: Pair plain-language labels with exact unit tokens and a consistent discoverable model-space glossary; keep precision in expert detail and never replace proxy units with physical units.

findings.current_behavior: Connectome structure, exploratory dynamics and derived outcomes are separated mainly through prose/provenance, not a common visible evidence grammar. LC4/LPLC2 names appear in looming details rather than the main causal stages.
findings.why_it_matters: Structural routing must not be mistaken for validated physiology.
findings.scientific_risk: No contact-count efficacy claim located; the evidence/model boundary requires careful reading.
findings.ux_impact: A newcomer cannot quickly identify which part is empirical versus assumed.
findings.phase33_remedy: Expose concise Structural route / Exploratory model / Recorded model result labels and name LC4/LPLC2 in the looming path using existing telemetry metadata.

findings.current_behavior: Mobile panels stack vertically without horizontal overflow, but the neural page is about 4339 px tall and the course page about 5640 px with provenance expanded. Course interpretation starts around y=1844 px.
findings.why_it_matters: Responsive layout should preserve the main result and causal meaning early.
findings.scientific_risk: No scientific data loss or fake state observed.
findings.ux_impact: Long scrolling delays interpretation; six source cards occupy much of the neural page.
findings.phase33_remedy: Place identity/input, viewport, concise result and reachable transport first; condense causal stages and group secondary identities/provenance without dropping data.

findings.current_behavior: Navigation/back-link focus removes outlines and changes text color only. Transport has a visible 2 px outline; native summaries remain keyboard operable.
findings.why_it_matters: Keyboard focus should be recognizable independently of color.
findings.ux_impact: Navigation focus is less robust than transport focus.
findings.phase33_remedy: Provide consistent non-color-only focus indicators for links, controls and summaries; preserve logical tab order and native keyboard behavior.

findings.current_behavior: Measured Run/Play/Reset controls are 40 px high on mobile; scientific labels can be 9–13 px.
findings.why_it_matters: Small targets and dense labels merit a practical readability review.
findings.scientific_risk: No inaccessible scientific value was demonstrated.
findings.ux_impact: Touch/low-vision interaction could be less comfortable.
findings.phase33_remedy: Review touch hit areas and legibility at supported mobile sizes; do not claim WCAG conformance from this limited audit.

findings.current_behavior: Collapsed provenance is appropriately secondary, but expanded course provenance is a long list of raw 64-character IDs and machine-oriented status terms.
findings.why_it_matters: Experts need authority identity without making newcomers decode hashes.
findings.ux_impact: Expanded detail is verbose and difficult to scan.
findings.phase33_remedy: Group evidence, model contracts and run identity with plain-language explanations and optional copy controls; retain full IDs and excluded-edge information.

findings.current_behavior: Baseline uses 'No sensory response yet' while marked DISABLED. 'Genuine' actuation/response is not defined for a newcomer.
findings.why_it_matters: Control-neutral language and model-derived language should be consistent.
findings.scientific_risk: Potential expectation of later baseline activity; no actual false movement or physiological claim is made.
findings.phase33_remedy: Use control-specific neutral wording and explain recorded model output versus injected presentation; preserve intentional silence and valid null results.

findings.current_behavior: One solid object and dashed guide are clear; static labels can detach from the moving object, and dense grid/shadow cues compete with thin legs at final approach.
findings.why_it_matters: Depth cues should support stimulus interpretation, not apparent physics.
findings.scientific_risk: Scene guide already says grid/shadows are presentation, not contact mechanics.
findings.ux_impact: Scene is readable but small visual details are busy.
findings.phase33_remedy: Keep one authoritative object; anchor presentation labels clearly and restrain grid/guide clutter without altering geometry, trajectory, camera-derived scientific values or body outputs.

findings.current_behavior: Local replay waits were multi-second: circuit approximately 6.6–6.8 s, world approximately 16.4–17.2 s; baseline Run showed 13.7 s during concurrent audit requests. New neural/course restores were about 222/660 ms.
findings.why_it_matters: A long validated replay must remain visibly distinct from an empty result.
findings.scientific_risk: Do not weaken validation or invent progress/state to hide latency.
findings.ux_impact: Uncertainty during loading, particularly on restored replay URLs.
findings.phase33_remedy: Keep the scenario shell and accessible validation/loading explanation visible, with honest wait and retry messaging; profile replay cost separately before proposing an authority-preserving adapter optimization.

findings.current_behavior: An actual absent-artifact 503 removes the canvas and gives source-artifact/retry guidance. Only course-control copy explicitly states that no synthetic fallback was substituted.
findings.why_it_matters: Scientific unavailability should use consistent plain language.
findings.scientific_risk: No fallback scientific data occurred; assurance is uneven.
findings.ux_impact: Earlier scenarios use technical replay-validation wording.
findings.phase33_remedy: Use a consistent artifact-unavailable panel with explicit no-fallback assurance, in-context Retry and back navigation; retain typed errors and no visualization when scientific data are unavailable.

findings.current_behavior: Specimen silhouette, wings and eyes are identifiable, but body forms and rod-like legs are simplified; wings/materials lack fine anatomical detail. Some leg/shadow overlap is camera/lighting presentation, not mesh anatomy.
findings.why_it_matters: Asset shortcomings must not be attributed to the neural/body model or fixed by scientific tuning.
findings.scientific_risk: The asset is labelled a visual specimen, not validated anatomy or biomechanics.
findings.ux_impact: Appearance can dominate expectations of biological realism.
findings.phase33_remedy: Preserve an unobtrusive visual-asset disclaimer; separate any future asset project from Phase33 layout work. Do not replace the fly or add mechanics in the redesign.

stage_b.reason: No CRITICAL/HIGH local semantic or blocking bug located. Medium/low design issues belong to Phase33; no aesthetic cleanup authorized.

items: DNp01 model state and subthreshold/event result where defined
Yaw drive with exploratory transform label
Repeated stationary/no-command verdicts and constant zero position in separate large cells
Combining yaw-drive magnitude and clipping YES/NO on one numeric line

drift: body movement versus orientation-only output scope

claim_audit.limits: This is not a completeness proof of all product copy. Reviewed scenario catalog/cockpits/viewport/explanations/provenance; no learning, consciousness, fake optic-flow calibration, physiological voltage or complete-network claim found.

interaction_checks.play_pause: PASS; neural playback advanced to boundary 47 and stayed paused
interaction_checks.scrub: PASS; Home/End/PageUp yield authoritative boundaries; allowed React update time before comparison
interaction_checks.navigation_focus: RISK; outline none, text-color change only
interaction_checks.mobile_overflow: NONE_LOCATED in reviewed complex/looming views including expanded course provenance
interaction_checks.error: PASS; real missing source path returned typed 503, removed canvas; canonical retry recovered
interaction_checks.loading_null_distinction: CLEAR for interactive Run; replay restoration waits merit shell/loading hierarchy review

performance_observations.playback: No obvious sustained jank in brief play/pause/scrub inspection; no FPS benchmark collected.
performance_observations.provenance: Immediate native expansion, no overflow; long content rather than slow processing.
performance_observations.upstream_warning: THREE.Clock deprecated in favor of THREE.Timer; observed in all R3F variants, no runtime error or refactor required.

requirements.requirement: Use identity/input, dominant viewport, concise current result, causal explanation, transport, telemetry, then provenance as the primary reading hierarchy.
requirements.acceptance: Current outcome and body-output reason are discoverable without opening provenance; desktop/mobile reading order tested.

requirements.requirement: Render only backend-authoritative values. Preserve the five scenario identities, payloads, model-space units and exclusions.
requirements.acceptance: No scientific kernel/config/artifact changes, frontend integration or fake fallback; regressions and contract parity pass.

requirements.requirement: Compact comparison of control, micro-window, world experiment, neural-only slice and exploratory closed loop.
requirements.acceptance: Every card exposes class, scientific duration, input, body-output scope and honest canonical result; no five interchangeable simulations.

requirements.requirement: Present neutral baseline as an intentional no-stimulus control.
requirements.acceptance: No movement/response expectation, no loading/failure confusion, no locomotor-baseline claim.

requirements.requirement: Preserve 1.4 ms micro-window versus 40 ms preregistered model-space world roles and the honest null motor outcome.
requirements.acceptance: LC4/LPLC2 route named, subthreshold DNp01 and zero actual actuation clear; no biological escape/timing claim.

requirements.requirement: Create a distinct neural-only viewport pattern pairing controlled descriptor with the selected eight-node, six-route identity motif.
requirements.acceptance: Six sources/two targets preserved; no fly/body mapping, spikes, active context edges, fake retinal imagery or structural-count signal scaling.

requirements.requirement: Make counter-motion and residual offset comprehensible through truthful readouts/annotations, not larger angles.
requirements.acceptance: World reference is not a goal; direct specimen orientation retained; no heading restoration, gain tuning, torque or translation.

requirements.requirement: Use a shared current-result grammar distinguishing selected boundary, whole canonical run, valid null and not-defined output.
requirements.acceptance: Baseline neutral, looming subthreshold/stationary, neural unilateral readout and course residual have distinct summaries.

requirements.requirement: Pair plain-language labels and stable model-space unit tokens with a compact glossary.
Place compact causal understanding before dense telemetry; use a clearly delayed return path for the closed loop.
requirements.acceptance: Active/neutral/disabled/not-defined states are distinguished with text; no missing/mirrored/extra edges or instantaneous feedback implied.

requirements.requirement: Prioritize identity/input, viewport, current result and transport on mobile; group secondary detail.
requirements.acceptance: At 390–430 px, no horizontal overflow with details opened; core result does not require traversing every telemetry/source card.

requirements.requirement: Provide non-color-only focus, keyboard transport/provenance, readable labels and comfortable touch targets.
requirements.acceptance: Tab/Enter/Home/End tests, visible focus, textual R/L/sign states and mobile hit-area inspection; no unsupported WCAG-conformance claim.

requirements.requirement: Keep provenance collapsed/secondary; group empirical structure, exploratory assumptions and result authorities.
requirements.acceptance: Full hashes/identities and excluded context remain available; expansions readable on mobile without forcing hash decoding for the main story.

requirements.requirement: Give the scientific timeline meaningful stimulus/perturbation/recovery/end annotations from existing authoritative data.
requirements.acceptance: Play/Pause/Reset/Scrub synchronized; 6 s presentation versus scientific horizon explicit; final residual not auto-zeroed.

requirements.requirement: Use essential primary telemetry and progressive disclosure of secondary/provenance values.
requirements.acceptance: No redundant empty card, R/L paired consistently, signs/zero preserved, no invented thresholds or events.

requirements.requirement: Present clear scientific-artifact unavailability and honest loading without mock experiment state.
requirements.acceptance: Explicit no-fallback language across scenarios, accessible status/alert, contextual Retry/back, no canvas scientific result after failure.

requirements.requirement: Use Stitch only as visual inspiration for an immersive, restrained scientific layout.
requirements.acceptance: No science inferred from mockups; no new asset, decorative motion, global redesign or chart library in Phase32.

requirements.requirement: Preserve empirical routing versus model assumptions versus derived result and the v1/v2 freeze.
requirements.acceptance: No physiological efficacy from contact counts; no heading sensor, recurrence/electrical coupling, learning/consciousness or physical-body interpretation added.

screen_briefs.brief: Compact five-class selection; consistent duration/output/result metadata; avoid repeated caveat walls while retaining limits.
Dominant quiet specimen plus persistent intentional-control result; neutral/disabled language, no fake activity.
Name the LC4/LPLC2→DNp01 path; preserve 1.4 ms role, single object and subthreshold/stationary conclusion.
Make 40 ms preregistration and exposure/subthreshold growth visible; preserve zero genuine motor/body output.
Descriptor and bounded six-route motif with bilateral continuous readout; signed source identities secondary; no body/event display.
Fixed world reference, truthful orientation/readout, delayed loop and residual-offset status; motion sensing is not heading restoration.
Group structure, assumptions, exclusions and run identities; retain hashes, no mobile overflow.
Plain-language unavailable artifact/no synthetic fallback, contextual retry/back; no fabricated visualization.
Compact result-first reading path while retaining dominant viewport, reachable timeline and expandable identities/provenance.

scientific_invariants: All five identifiers and frozen payloads preserved
Neural-only viewport has no body mapping or spikes
Course orientation no translation, no heading sensor/restoration
Seven chemical context edges/electrical coupling remain excluded
No decorative motion or asset appearance supplies scientific evidence
phase33.stitch_alignment: Visual inspiration only in Phase33. Phase32 neither fetched nor implemented Stitch designs; science outranks visual mockup behavior.

audit.next_action: Create a bounded Phase33 visual-system redesign specification for the five scenario screens using this audit and frozen scientific invariants.
